category_title: Minimally verbal young children with severe ASD and language processing deficits
minimal_context: The student is in a one-on-one structured task and is asked to match a common object to an array of photos.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a spoon. Look at these three photos on the table. Match the spoon to the correct photo.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not produce any meaningful vocalizations or words, and engages in primarily exploratory play with the spoon instead of looking at the photos.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Listen to me. Pick the correct picture for the spoon.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues exploratory play with the object, lacking symbolic play, and does not pick a picture from the array.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's try again. Put the spoon on the matching picture.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Performs inconsistently in object and picture identification, placing the spoon on the wrong photo without producing any meaningful vocalizations.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is a spoon. Look at these three photos on the table. Match the spoon to the correct photo.

STUDENT: (Does not produce any meaningful vocalizations or words, and engages in primarily exploratory play with the spoon instead of looking at the photos.)

TUTOR: Listen to me. Pick the correct picture for the spoon.

STUDENT: (Continues exploratory play with the object, lacking symbolic play, and does not pick a picture from the array.)

TUTOR: Let's try again. Put the spoon on the matching picture.

STUDENT: (Performs inconsistently in object and picture identification, placing the spoon on the wrong photo without producing any meaningful vocalizations.)

task.content: match object to an array of two to three pictures
task.learning_goal: improve on three main areas, namely communication and preverbal skills, language comprehension and, speech and language production

context.materials: common objects, such as cup, spoon, comb and key, photos of the exact objects, picture cards and line drawings

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: perform inconsistently in object and picture identification

behavior_patterns.condition: During assessment of object and picture identification
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: could only identify the common objects and pictures correctly 10% of the time
